title: Why Nvidia doesn't have all of 'its eggs in the OpenAI basket'
text: The Wall Street Journal reported that Nvidia's (NVDA) plan to invest $100 billion into OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) — announced back in September 2025 — is currently stalled, according to inside sources. Creative Strategies Senior Analyst Austin Lyons discusses what this news could mean for these two AI giants.
